title: Anatomical Compartmentalization in Chickens Drives Divergent H9N2 Influenza Evolution Toward Human Receptor Binding and Immune Escape.
abstract: ABSTRACT Avian influenza A(H9N2) viruses pose a pandemic threat, having acquired preferential binding to human receptors and the ability to evade immunity in chickens. However, the selective forces driving these traits remain unclear. Here, we show how anatomical compartmentalization within chickens shapes hemagglutinin (HA) evolution. Using deep mutational scanning coupled with in vivo studies, we find that pre‐existing immunity reduces viral load and blocks transmission, thereby imposing strong selection on viral diversity. Distinct tissues exert divergent selection pressures in immunized chickens. The upper respiratory tract mainly enriches viruses with high‐affinity binding to human‐type receptors, whereas the lower respiratory tract preferentially favors antibody‐escape viruses. This functional difference was validated using variants carrying defined substitutions, which showed fitness aligned with their respective compartment. Our results demonstrate that tissue‐specific selection within an avian host can concurrently shape viral diversity toward human adaptation and immune evasion, providing a mechanism for the emergence of variants with pandemic potential in poultry.

title: H9N2 avian influenza virus in Bangladesh: three genetically distinct co-circulating subgroups retain a largely conserved antigenic phenotype
abstract: Abstract Low pathogenic avian influenza (LPAI) H9N2 viruses are endemic in poultry across Bangladesh, causing substantial economic losses and posing a persistent zoonotic risk. Although genetic surveillance has documented ongoing viral evolution, the relationship between genetic diversification and antigenic change remains poorly understood. This study investigated the genetic diversity, reassortment, and antigenic characteristics of contemporary H9N2 viruses circulating in Bangladesh. Phylogenetic analysis of 219 sampled sequences revealed three genetically distinct monophyletic haemagglutinin (HA) G-lineage sub-groups, each characterised by unique amino acid substitutions. In contrast, neuraminidase (NA) displayed similar genetic diversity without distinct phylogenetic clusters. A dual-metric analysis of paired HA and NA phylogenies identified 20 putative reassortant H9N2 viruses. Further analysis showed that genetic diversity was geographically structured; however, all three HA subgroups co-circulated across multiple regions, and some live bird markets contained representatives of all three groups simultaneously, suggesting that live bird markets may facilitate mixing between genetically distinct viruses, and create opportunities for reassortment among otherwise geographically separated strains. Despite substantial genetic diversity and reassortment, all viruses remained antigenically similar based on haemagglutination inhibition and virus neutralisation assays. However, a representative strain from one subgroup induced significantly lower homologous and heterologous antibody titres, suggesting reduced immunogenicity. Our findings demonstrate a notable disconnect between genetic evolution and antigenic change in Bangladeshi H9N2 viruses. While reassortment and genetic diversification continue to shape viral populations, antigenic properties remain largely conserved, supporting the continued relevance of current vaccine strategies while highlighting the importance of ongoing genetic and antigenic surveillance. Importance Low pathogenic avian influenza (LPAI) H9N2 viruses remain endemic in Bangladesh and continue to evolve through genetic diversification and reassortment. This study demonstrates that, despite the emergence of three distinct HA genetic subgroups and frequent reassortment events, contemporary Bangladeshi H9N2 viruses remain antigenically conserved. These findings reveal an important disconnect between genetic evolution and antigenic change, indicating that genetic divergence alone may not predict vaccine effectiveness. The co-circulation of multiple viral subgroups within live bird markets highlights their role as hubs for viral mixing and reassortment, emphasizing the need for targeted surveillance in these settings. While current vaccine strategies are likely to remain effective against circulating strains, the identification of a subgroup with reduced immunogenicity underscores the importance of continued monitoring of both genetic and phenotypic traits. Together, these findings provide critical evidence to support risk assessment, vaccine evaluation, and avian influenza control programmes in Bangladesh and beyond.

abstract_zh: 摘要 低致病性 禽流感 (LPAI) H9N2 病毒在孟加拉国家禽中流行,造成重大经济损失并构成持续的人畜共患风险。尽管遗传监测已经记录了正在进行的病毒进化,但遗传多样性和抗原变化之间的关系仍然知之甚少。这项研究调查了孟加拉国流行的当代 H9N2 病毒的遗传多样性、重排和抗原特征。对 219 个采样序列的系统发育分析揭示了三个遗传上不同的单系血凝素 (HA) G 谱系亚群,每个亚群都以独特的氨基酸取代为特征。相比之下,神经氨酸酶(NA)表现出相似的遗传多样性,但没有明显的系统发育簇。对配对 HA 和 NA 系统发育的双度量分析确定了 20 种假定的重配 H9N2 病毒。进一步分析表明,遗传多样性具有地理结构;然而,所有三个HA亚群在多个地区共同流通,并且一些活禽市场同时包含所有三个亚群的代表,这表明活禽市场可能促进遗传上不同的病毒之间的混合,并为其他地理上分离的毒株之间的重配创造机会。尽管存在大量的遗传多样性和重配,但根据血凝抑制和病毒中和测定,所有病毒在抗原上仍然相似。然而,一个亚组的代表性菌株诱导的同源和异源抗体滴度显着降低,表明免疫原性降低。我们的研究结果表明,孟加拉国 H9N2 病毒的 进化 基因与抗原变化之间存在显着脱节。虽然重配和遗传多样化继续塑造病毒种群,但抗原特性在很大程度上仍然保守,支持当前 疫苗 策略的持续相关性,同时强调持续遗传和抗原 监测 的重要性。重要性 低致病性 禽流感 (LPAI) H9N2 病毒在孟加拉国仍然流行,并通过遗传多样化和重组继续进化。这项研究表明,尽管出现了三个不同的 HA 遗传亚群和频繁的重配事件,当代孟加拉国 H9N2 病毒仍然保持抗原保守性。这些发现揭示了遗传 进化 和抗原变化之间的重要脱节,表明仅遗传差异可能无法预测 疫苗 的有效性。活禽市场内多个病毒亚群的共同循环凸显了它们作为病毒混合和重组中心的作用,强调了在这些环境中需要有针对性的 监测。虽然目前的 疫苗 策略可能对流行菌株仍然有效,但免疫原性降低的亚组的鉴定强调了持续监测遗传和表型特征的重要性。总之,这些发现为支持孟加拉国及其他地区的风险评估、疫苗 评估和 禽流感 控制计划提供了关键证据。

title: Protective and Cross-Protective Efficacies of Inactivated Recombinant H5N1 and H5N8 Vaccines Against Highly-Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5-Type Strains in Chickens
abstract: Abstract Background Co-circulation of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 and H5N8 viruses (clade 2.3.4.4b) threatens poultry production and public health, so vaccines that protect against both viruses are needed. This study evaluated the immunogenicity and cross-protective efficacy of inactivated recombinant (reverse genetics-derived) rgH5N1 and rgH5N8 vaccines (10 8.0 50% embryo infectious dose [EID 50 ]/dose) against homologous and heterologous HPAI H5-type challenge in specific-pathogen-free (SPF) chickens. Vaccine strains were inactivated with 0.2% formalin and emulsified with Montanide ISA 71 VG adjuvant. SPF chickens (n = 10 per group) received rgH5N1 (G1), rgH5N8 (G2), or phosphate-buffered saline (G3, unvaccinated controls). Hemagglutination inhibition (HI) titers were measured at weeks 2, 3, and 4 post-vaccination. At week 4, birds were challenged intranasally with homologous or heterologous HPAI virus (10 6 EID 50 /0.1 mL) and monitored for 10 days for clinical signs and mortality; viral shedding was assessed by real-time RT-PCR. Both vaccines induced HI responses that peaked at weeks 3–4. The rgH5N1 vaccine elicited high cross-reactive titers against H5N8 (9.2–9.4 log 2 ), whereas the rgH5N8 vaccine elicited lower cross-reactive titers against H5N1 (7.25 log 2 ). Both vaccines conferred 100% survival and no detectable viral shedding (cycle threshold [Ct] > 38) after homologous and heterologous challenge. All unvaccinated controls died, with high viral loads detected from day 3. Both inactivated vaccines provided complete cross-protection against heterologous H5-type challenge under controlled conditions, preventing mortality and detectable viral shedding. This supports their potential for controlling co-circulating H5N1 and H5N8 viruses in poultry, although confirmation in larger groups under field conditions is needed.

title_zh: 灭活重组 H5N1 和 H5N8 疫苗 对鸡高致病性 禽流感 H5 型菌株的保护和交叉保护功效
source_body_en: Abstract Background Co-circulation of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 and H5N8 viruses (clade 2.3.4.4b) threatens poultry production and public health, so vaccines that protect against both viruses are needed. Vaccine strains were inactivated with 0.2% formalin and emulsified with Montanide ISA 71 VG adjuvant. SPF chickens (n = 10 per group) received rgH5N1 (G1), rgH5N8 (G2), or phosphate-buffered saline (G3, unvaccinated controls). Hemagglutination inhibition (HI) titers were measured at weeks 2, 3, and 4 post-vaccination. At week 4, birds were challenged intranasally with homologous or heterologous HPAI virus (10 6 EID 50 /0.1 mL) and monitored for 10 days for clinical signs and mortality; viral shedding was assessed by real-time RT-PCR. Both vaccines induced HI responses that peaked at weeks 3–4. The rgH5N1 vaccine elicited high cross-reactive titers against H5N8 (9.2–9.4 log 2 ), whereas the rgH5N8 vaccine elicited lower cross-reactive titers against H5N1 (7.25 log 2 ). Both vaccines conferred 100% survival and no detectable viral shedding (cycle threshold [Ct] > 38) after homologous and heterologous challenge. All unvaccinated controls died, with high viral loads detected from day 3. Both inactivated vaccines provided complete cross-protection against heterologous H5-type challenge under controlled conditions, preventing mortality and detectable viral shedding. This supports their potential for controlling co-circulating H5N1 and H5N8 viruses in poultry, although confirmation in larger groups under field conditions is needed.

title: Characterization and vaccine-induced immunity of a novel H6N2 avian influenza reassortant virus with H9N2-derived NA and internal genes from poultry in Henan, China
abstract: Abstract In December 2025, an H6N2 avian influenza virus (A/chicken/Henan/NL04/2025, NL04) was isolated from a chicken outbreak in Henan, China with 15% field mortality and severe respiratory disease. Genome sequencing confirmed it is a novel reassortant possessing a waterfowl‐origin H6‐derived HA, H9N2‐derived NA, and the complete internal‐gene cassette of the H9N2 G57 genotype. Although NL04 caused only mild clinical disease and 100% survival in experimentally infected specific-pathogen-free (SPF) chickens, prominent respiratory‐tract histopathological damage was observed, revealing a marked phenotypic discrepancy between laboratory outcomes and severe field‐reported mortality that is likely driven by complex commercial‐farm risk factors. Tissue viral loads in SPF chickens peaked in nasal turbinates and the Harderian gland, confirming its predominant respiratory tropism. In BALB/c mice, NL04 exhibited limited nasal replication, indicating low mammalian‐adaptation potential. We further evaluated an inactivated vaccine candidate based on NL04. The vaccine induced robust humoral immunity, reduced viral shedding after homologous challenge, and elicited cross‐neutralizing antibodies against a heterologous H6N1 isolate. Our findings highlight the veterinary relevance of this unique H6N2 reassortant and stress the value of continuous genomic surveillance among poultry to prevent emerging avian‐influenza threats.

abstract_zh: 摘要 2025 年 12 月,从中国河南的一只鸡 暴发 中分离到 H6N2 死亡率 病毒(A/chicken/Henan/NL04/2025,NL04),该病毒具有 15% 的田 死亡率 并伴有严重呼吸道疾病。基因组 测序证实它是一种新型重配体,具有水禽来源的 H6 衍生的 HA、H9N2 衍生的 NA 和 H9N2 G57 基因型的完整内部基因盒。尽管 NL04 仅引起轻微的临床疾病,且实验感染的无特定病原体 (SPF) 鸡的存活率为 100%,但观察到显着的呼吸道组织病理学损伤,揭示实验室结果与现场报告的严重 死亡率 之间存在显着的表型差异,这可能是由复杂的商业农场风险因素驱动的。SPF 鸡的组织病毒载量在鼻甲和哈德氏腺中达到峰值,证实了其主要的呼吸道趋向性。在 BALB/c 小鼠中,NL04 表现出有限的鼻腔复制,表明哺乳动物适应潜力较低。我们进一步评估了基于 NL04 的灭活 疫苗 候选药物。疫苗 诱导强大的体液免疫,减少同源攻击后的病毒脱落,并引发针对异源 H6N1 分离株的交叉中和抗体。我们的研究结果强调了这种独特的 H6N2 重配病毒的兽医相关性,并强调了在家禽中连续 基因组监测 预防新出现的禽流感威胁的价值。

title: Serologic Evidence of Avian Influenza Virus Exposure in Livestock, Egypt, 2024–2026
abstract: Spillover of influenza A(H5N1) virus to cattle in the United States sparked global concern. We investigated whether endemic avian influenza viruses are potentially spilling over into domestic livestock in Egypt. We detected influenza H9N2 antibodies in 2.5% and H5N1 antibodies in 2.9%-4.5% of tested animals. Additional surveillance will elucidate host infection dynamics.

title: Genetic characterization of avian influenza H14 viruses in Guangdong, China: evidence of intercontinental transmission and reassortment in the East Asian-Australasian flyway.
abstract: H14 avian influenza viruses (AIVs) are rare, with limited data on their circulation in mainland China. This study investigated the ecological origins and zoonotic potential of H14 viruses in southern China. The isolates were characterised by full-genome sequencing and phylogenetic analysis, together with assessment of avian- and human-type receptor binding, in vitro replication in avian, mammalian, and human cell lines, and in vivo pathogenicity in mice. Four H14 AIVs (one H14N6, two H14N7, and one H14N8) were isolated. We identified a novel H14 transmission network involving Mareca penelope and various shorebird species, indicating a multihost dispersal mechanism. Guangdong isolates formed a distinct subclade within the Eurasian lineage, closely related to Russian and Cambodian strains. The isolates (SZ3742/H14N6, ZJ3523/H14N7, SZ3536/H14N8) exhibited dual receptor-binding specificity for avian (α-2,3) and human (α-2,6) sialic acids. Strain-dependent replication in human A549 cells showed SZ3742/H14N6 peaked comparably to DF-1 cells but lower than MDCK cells, while the others had lower peak titres. All isolates replicated transiently at low titres in mouse lungs with limited pathogenicity. Molecular characterisation revealed mammalian adaptation markers and a typical HA cleavage site motif (PDKQTR↓GLF). This study presents the first evidence of H14 AIV circulation in Guangdong, emphasising the need for enhanced surveillance in the East Asian -Australasian Flyway.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: H14 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 非常罕见,有关其在中国大陆传播的数据有限。本研究调查了中国南方 H14 病毒的生态起源和人畜共患潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注中国南部(特别是广东)的 禽流感 病毒,并检查了它们在东亚-澳大利亚迁飞路线中的 传播 和重配模式。
elements_zh.methods: 通过全 基因组 测序和系统发育分析,以及对禽类和人型受体结合、禽类、哺乳动物和人细胞系的体外复制以及小鼠体内致病性的评估,对分离株进行了表征。
elements_zh.main_results: 分离出四种 H14 AIV(一种 H14N6、两种 H14N7 和一种 H14N8)。我们发现了一个新的 H14 传播 网络,涉及 Mareca penelope 和各种滨鸟物种,表明多宿主传播机制。人 A549 细胞中的菌株依赖性复制显示,SZ3742/H14N6 的峰值与 DF-1 细胞相当,但低于 MDCK 细胞,而其他细胞的峰值滴度较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究首次提供了 H14 AIV 在广东省传播的证据,强调了在东亚-澳大利亚迁飞路线中加强 监测 的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这项研究提供了对 H14 AIV 生态动态的重要见解,可以为东亚-澳大利亚迁飞路线的针对性 监测 和预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对单一地理区域的关注以及体外和体内模型的使用而受到限制,这可能无法完全代表自然的 传播 动力学。由于分离株数量有限且缺乏直接的人类感染数据,证据强度中等。

Molecular characterisation revealed mammalian adaptation markers and a typical HA cleavage site motif (PDKQTR↓GLF). title: Poultry and Livestock Disease Surveillance, Diagnosis, and Control
abstract: Abstract Infectious diseases of poultry and ruminants limit production, disrupt trade and threaten human health. The last decade brought panzootic H5N1 avian influenza, its spillover into dairy cattle, and incursions of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), peste des petits ruminants (PPR) and lumpy skin disease into Europe. This critical review compares diagnostic, surveillance and prevention approaches for priority diseases of poultry (avian influenza, Newcastle disease, Marek's disease, coccidiosis, fowlpox) and ruminants (FMD, brucellosis, bovine tuberculosis, PPR, lumpy skin disease, bluetongue) in literature published between 2015 and 2026, with global coverage and attention to low- and middle-income countries. Diseases were prioritised using five explicit criteria. The synthesis shows that test performance depends on purpose, specimen and prevalence, and that access and logistics limit diagnosis more often than assay chemistry. Vaccines can reshape pathogen populations, as leaky Marek's disease vaccines and FMD carrier animals illustrate, so vaccination needs matched monitoring. Economic estimates rest on incompatible methods, cross-species surveillance is needed after H5N1 emerged in cattle, and antimicrobial stewardship is essential in poultry. We propose a tiered surveillance–diagnostic–intervention workflow for resource-limited settings and list research priorities, including field validation of rapid and genomic tools and harmonised economic frameworks.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对家禽和反刍动物重点疾病的诊断、监测 和预防方法进行了严格审查,重点关注 2015 年至 2026 年间发表的文献,覆盖全球并关注低收入和中等收入国家。
elements_zh.methods: 该综合比较了跨疾病的诊断、监测 和预防方法,强调了测试性能如何受到目的、样本类型和 患病率 的影响,以及获取和物流如何比分析化学对 诊断 的影响更大。
elements_zh.main_results: 该审查确定了疾病优先顺序的五个明确标准,并强调了基于这些因素的诊断有效性的可变性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,疫苗 可以改变病原体种群,正如马立克氏病和 FMD 所见,并且 疫苗接种 策略必须伴随适当的监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要量身定制的 监测 和诊断方法以及统一的经济框架,以在资源有限的环境中有效管理 禽流感 和相关疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对现有文献的依赖以及经济估计方法潜在的不兼容而受到限制,但由于其全面的全球覆盖范围和对低收入和中等收入国家的关注,证据是强有力的。

title: An air of possibility: a systematic review of windborne transmission of avian influenza virus in poultry
abstract: Abstract High pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) poses significant risks to poultry production, wildlife conservation, and public health. While direct contact primarily drives avian influenza virus (AIV) spread within infected flocks, introduction onto farms is more often attributed to indirect routes, including environmental contamination from wildlife reservoirs and transmission from other infected premises. Among plausible transmission pathways, the potential for windborne transmission remains a critical knowledge gap. We conducted a systematic review to assess current understanding of windborne AIV transmission in poultry. We searched two databases using terms related to influenza, poultry, and windborne transmission. Of 414 manuscripts identified, 47 met inclusion criteria. Most studies were conducted in the Netherlands ( n = 9) and the United States ( n = 9). Research primarily focused on high pathogenicity H5 strains ( n = 25) in commercial settings. The majority of studies ( n = 33) were published after 2014 following the emergence of HPAIV H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b. Findings suggest that environmental factors such as wind speed and direction may facilitate virus spread over several kilometers; however, findings were inconsistent across experimental studies, field investigations, and modelling analyses. Windborne transmission may contribute to outbreak dynamics, particularly in high-density production areas, but its relative importance remains uncertain. Several studies recommend incorporating wind parameters into outbreak investigations and strengthening biosecurity measures, such as air filtration and wind barriers. While windborne transmission of AIV is a plausible and potentially significant route of spread, further research is needed to improve detection methods, refine predictive models, and address gaps in real-time field data linking virus detection to actual transmission events. This will enhance our capacity to prevent and control AIV outbreaks, especially in high-risk regions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review explores the potential for windborne transmission of avian influenza A viruses in poultry. While direct contact is the primary driver of AIV spread within flocks, indirect routes, including windborne transmission, are considered critical for virus introduction onto farms. The review highlights that environmental factors like wind speed and direction may facilitate virus spread over several kilometers, but findings remain inconsistent across experimental studies, field investigations, and modeling analyses. Windborne transmission could influence outbreak dynamics, particularly in high-density production areas, though its relative importance is uncertain. The review underscores the need for improved detection methods, refined predictive models, and real-time field data to better understand the role of windborne transmission. It also recommends incorporating wind parameters into outbreak investigations and enhancing biosecurity measures, such as air filtration and wind barriers, to mitigate risks. These findings aim to improve prevention and control strategies for AIV outbreaks in high-risk regions.

title: Optimizing Avian Influenza Viral RNA Enrichment from Water: A Comparison of Concentration Methods for Low-Volume Samples
abstract: Abstract Feed-baited water bins may provide a complementary approach for avian influenza virus (AIV) surveillance in wild waterbird populations. In a previous study, water from these bins was sampled using swabs after exposure to visiting birds, but the low sample volume limited the detection and subsequent characterization of AIV RNA (F. Homeier-Bachmann, L. Globig, One Health 23:101548, 2026, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.onehlt.2026.101548). Here, we compared five sample-processing methods for improving AIV RNA detection in small (40-mL) water samples (tap and brackish water) spiked with an AIV of the H4N6 subtype under simulated field conditions: swab sampling, polyethylene glycol precipitation, activated carbon capture, combined activated carbon capture and polyethylene glycol precipitation (AC/PEG), and electronegative membrane adsorption (EM). AC/PEG and EM showed the strongest overall performance based on RT-qPCR results, although their relative performance varied across experimental conditions. The qPCR-derived viral signal was generally higher in tap water than in brackish water, whereas wheat presence was associated with a lower signal, particularly for swab sampling. Subsequent testing was conducted to ascertain the most effective storage conditions with regard to temperature and duration. During storage, AIV RNA detection remained relatively stable at −20 °C for up to four weeks, with only minor increases in mean Ct values in both water matrices. Greater increases were observed at room temperature and 4 °C, with significantly higher Ct values at both temperatures than at −20 °C in both water matrices at Weeks 2 and 4 ( p < 0.05). These findings support the potential of AC/PEG and EM to facilitate the recovery, detection and subsequent characterization of AIV from low-volume water samples by improving viral RNA detection using RT-qPCR. Given its overall performance and lower cost compared with EM, AC/PEG may represent a practical option for field-based surveillance. Regarding storage, −20 °C provided the best conditions for maintaining AIV RNA detection, with relatively stable results for up to four weeks. Importance Environmental surveillance can complement conventional approaches for detecting avian influenza virus (AIV) circulation in wild waterbirds. Feed-baited water bins offer a non-invasive sampling strategy, but processing low-volume water samples may require viral enrichment to improve AIV RNA detection. Here, we show that combined activated carbon capture and polyethylene glycol precipitation (AC/PEG) is a promising, cost-effective method for improving AIV RNA detection in low-volume water samples. These findings highlight the potential of viral enrichment methods to support the use of simple, practical and non-invasive approaches for AIV surveillance.

title: Pre-existing cross-subtype serological responses against H5Nx in health care workers
abstract: ABSTRACT A rise in cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in humans has been reported since 2023. Although influenza seasonal vaccination (H1N1/H3N2) was shown to be effective against cases of reinfection with endemic influenza A viruses (IAVs), its capacity to elicit cross-reactive antibodies against (H5N1) remains unclear. Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

title_zh: 医护人员中已存在针对 H5Nx 的跨亚型血清学反应
source_body_en: ABSTRACT A rise in cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in humans has been reported since 2023. Although influenza seasonal vaccination (H1N1/H3N2) was shown to be effective against cases of reinfection with endemic influenza A viruses (IAVs), its capacity to elicit cross-reactive antibodies against (H5N1) remains unclear. Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

title: Bovine myxovirus resistance protein (Mx)1, but not Mx2, mediates antiviral activity against human and avian influenza A viruses, including H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b
abstract: ABSTRACT Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses have recently infected dairy cows in the United States, raising concerns about human spillover. The antiviral roles of bovine host defense factors, including myxovirus resistance proteins (bMx1 and bMx2), remain relatively understudied. We examined bMx1/bMx2 induction in differentiated bovine cells following HPAI H5N1 infection and assessed their antiviral activity using overexpression, knockdown, and mutagenesis approaches. Both bMx1 and bMx2 were more strongly induced in mammary cells than in tracheal cells. Overexpression of bMx1, but not bMx2, significantly inhibited seasonal influenza A viruses (IAVs), low-pathogenic, and highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses, including H5N1 2.3.4.4b, but not influenza B viruses. Conversely, knockdown of bMx1 resulted in enhanced IAV growth. Further, bMx1 inhibited early stages of viral replication, acting to reduce viral transcription and subsequent steps in the viral replication cycle. Known mutations that reduce human MxA (hMxA) activity also impaired bMx1 function, and mutations in the viral nucleoprotein (NP) associated with resistance to hMxA also reduced virus sensitivity to bMx1. Furthermore, phylogenetic analysis showed that a small minority (>0.03%) of avian H5N1 2.3.4.4b viruses already carry some of these NP mutations. These findings suggest that while current H5N1 viruses largely remain susceptible to bMx1, viral evolution or opportunistic reassortment could drive Mx resistance and increase pandemic risk. IMPORTANCE Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses have spilled over into dairy cows and have been circulating on dairy farms in the United States since 2024. The innate antiviral immune responses of cows to influenza viruses have not been extensively studied. In this study, we focused on Mx proteins, a key part of the innate immune defense system toward viruses. We specifically looked at bovine Mx proteins and demonstrated antiviral activity toward different influenza viruses, including the highly pathogenic strains. We also showed that the mechanism of antiviral activity of bovine Mx1 was very similar to that of the human equivalent MxA protein. Further, we found that a small minority of these avian viruses have mutations associated with resistance to both bovine Mx1 and human MxA proteins. Overall, this work highlights the elevated pandemic risk for highly pathogenic influenza viruses through continual circulation in cows, a mammalian species in close proximity to humans.

title_zh: 牛粘病毒抗性蛋白 (Mx)1(但不是 Mx2)介导 抗病毒药物 针对人类和 禽流感 A 病毒(包括 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b)的活性
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses have recently infected dairy cows in the United States, raising concerns about human spillover. The antiviral roles of bovine host defense factors, including myxovirus resistance proteins (bMx1 and bMx2), remain relatively understudied. We examined bMx1/bMx2 induction in differentiated bovine cells following HPAI H5N1 infection and assessed their antiviral activity using overexpression, knockdown, and mutagenesis approaches. Both bMx1 and bMx2 were more strongly induced in mammary cells than in tracheal cells. Overexpression of bMx1, but not bMx2, significantly inhibited seasonal influenza A viruses (IAVs), low-pathogenic, and highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses, including H5N1 2.3.4.4b, but not influenza B viruses. Conversely, knockdown of bMx1 resulted in enhanced IAV growth. Further, bMx1 inhibited early stages of viral replication, acting to reduce viral transcription and subsequent steps in the viral replication cycle. Known mutations that reduce human MxA (hMxA) activity also impaired bMx1 function, and mutations in the viral nucleoprotein (NP) associated with resistance to hMxA also reduced virus sensitivity to bMx1. Furthermore, phylogenetic analysis showed that a small minority (>0.03%) of avian H5N1 2.3.4.4b viruses already carry some of these NP mutations. These findings suggest that while current H5N1 viruses largely remain susceptible to bMx1, viral evolution or opportunistic reassortment could drive Mx resistance and increase pandemic risk. IMPORTANCE Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses have spilled over into dairy cows and have been circulating on dairy farms in the United States since 2024. The innate antiviral immune responses of cows to influenza viruses have not been extensively studied. In this study, we focused on Mx proteins, a key part of the innate immune defense system toward viruses. We specifically looked at bovine Mx proteins and demonstrated antiviral activity toward different influenza viruses, including the highly pathogenic strains. We also showed that the mechanism of antiviral activity of bovine Mx1 was very similar to that of the human equivalent MxA protein. Further, we found that a small minority of these avian viruses have mutations associated with resistance to both bovine Mx1 and human MxA proteins. Overall, this work highlights the elevated pandemic risk for highly pathogenic influenza viruses through continual circulation in cows, a mammalian species in close proximity to humans.

title: Efficacy of a Recombinant Newcastle Disease Virus Expressing H5N8 HA Against H5N1 Avian Influenza Virus (Clade 2.3.4.4b) in Broiler Chickens
abstract: Background: Since November 2022, the highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) virus subtype H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b has caused high mortality among wild birds and poultry in Peru. Vaccines, such as recombinant Newcastle disease virus (rNDV)-vectored vaccines expressing the hemagglutinin (HA) antigen of avian influenza virus (AIV), are considered effective for preventing AI; however, the HA protein in the vaccine must be antigenically matched to the field virus to prevent mortality and virus shedding caused by AI. In this study, we developed a live rNDV-vectored vaccine expressing an HA protein with antigenic similarity to the HA of field-circulating AIV. Methods: The rNDV rLS1 strain (the parental virus) was used as a viral vector to develop the rLS1-HAOpti vaccine (an rNDV expressing the HA protein of H5N8 clade 2.3.4.4b) through reverse genetics. The immunogenicity and efficacy of the live vaccine against an HPAI H5N1 (clade 2.3.4.4b) challenge were evaluated in broiler chickens. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了rNDV rLS1-HAOpti 疫苗在实验条件下对受到H5N1(进化枝2.3.4.4b)攻击的肉鸡的免疫原性和功效,涉及表达H5N8进化枝2.3.4.4b的HA蛋白的活rNDV载体疫苗。
elements_zh.methods: rNDV rLS1株被用作病毒媒介,通过反向遗传学开发rLS1-HAOpti 疫苗。通过评估 H5N1(进化枝 2.3.4.4b)攻击的肉鸡的血清体液反应和防止病毒脱落来评估 疫苗 的功效。
elements_zh.main_results: 疫苗 诱导显着的血清体液反应,在 H5N1 攻击后,它为大多数鸡提供保护并防止病毒脱落。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: rNDV 疫苗 候选药物在测试的实验条件下为受到 H5N1 攻击的肉鸡提供了针对 死亡率 和临床疾病的完全保护,证明了 疫苗 在家禽中预防 HPAI H5N1 的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,rNDV 疫苗 可能成为在家禽中预防 HPAI H5N1 的宝贵工具,通过降低病毒 传播 对人类的风险,为 禽流感 控制和公共卫生做出贡献。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用特定的实验挑战以及需要在现场环境中进行进一步评估。由于受控实验条件,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景:自 2022 年 11 月以来,高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 病毒亚型 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 导致秘鲁 野生鸟类 和家禽中 死亡率 较高。疫苗,例如表达禽流感病毒(AIV)血凝素(HA)抗原的重组新城疫病毒(rNDV)载体疫苗,被认为可有效预防AI;然而,疫苗中的HA蛋白必须与野外病毒抗原匹配,以防止死亡率和AI引起的病毒脱落。在这项研究中,我们开发了一种活 rNDV 载体 疫苗,其表达的 HA 蛋白与外地循环 AIV 的 HA 具有抗原相似性。方法:以rNDV rLS1毒株(亲本病毒)为病毒媒介,通过反向遗传学开发rLS1-HAOpti 疫苗(表达H5N8进化枝2.3.4.4b的HA蛋白的rNDV)。在肉鸡中评估了活 疫苗 针对 HPAI H5N1(进化枝 2.3.4.4b)攻击的免疫原性和功效。结果:疫苗 诱导显着的血清体液反应。H5N1 攻击后,疫苗 为大多数鸡提供了保护并防止病毒传播。结论:在测试的实验条件下,rNDV 疫苗 候选药物为 H5N1 攻击的肉鸡提供了针对 死亡率 和临床疾病的完全保护。

title: Inter-population connectivity of southern elephant seals and the likely intra-species transmission pathways of high pathogenicity avian influenza
abstract: High Pathogenicity Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b has spread beyond birds to affect seals across the Southern Ocean and sub-Antarctic region, with southern elephant seals ( Mirounga leonina ) particularly devastated. The virus, likely introduced via spillover from infected migratory birds, has killed tens of thousands of adult seals and pups throughout most of their range. We used twenty years of elephant seal movement data from the southern Indian and Pacific oceans to assess whether seal-to-seal transmission could spread HPAI H5N1 between breeding colonies, despite the vast distances separating them (Marion Island, Iles Crozet, Iles Kerguelen, and Macquarie Island). There was substantial overlap in seals’ at-sea distributions during their winter post-moult trips, when seals travel for weeks at average speeds of 3.5 km/h. Two transmission pathways were examined: (1) terrestrial “stepping stone” routes, where infected seals could pass the virus between colonies during short intervals to remain infectious were feasible from Marion Island to Kerguelen but not from Kerguelen to Macquarie Island; and (2) at-sea encounters between seals, which occurred frequently enough to enable transmission. The findings suggest that once established at Macquarie Island, the virus could potentially spread further to New Zealand’s sub-Antarctic islands and mainland New Zealand. While seal-to-seal transmission appears possible, we conclude this is unlikely. Nonetheless, understanding at-sea contact rates enhances knowledge of H5N1 epidemiology and demonstrates the value of combining long-term population monitoring with movement data to understand wildlife disease dynamics.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 已蔓延至鸟类以外,影响整个南大洋和亚南极地区的海豹,其中南象海豹 (Mirounga leonina) 受到的破坏尤其严重。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这种病毒很可能是通过 跨物种溢出 从受感染的候鸟那里引入的,已导致其大部分活动范围内数以万计的成年海豹和幼崽死亡。
elements_zh.methods: 我们使用来自南印度洋和太平洋的 20 年象海豹活动数据来评估海豹与海豹之间的 传播 是否可以在繁殖群体之间传播 HPAI H5N1,尽管这些群体之间相距甚远(马里恩岛、克罗泽岛、凯尔盖朗岛和麦格理岛)。
elements_zh.main_results: 海豹在冬季换羽后的旅行中,其海上分布存在大量重叠,海豹以平均 3.5 公里/小时的速度旅行数周。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究了两条 传播 途径:(1)陆地“踏脚石”路线,即受感染的海豹可以在短时间内在群体之间传播病毒以保持传染性,从马里恩岛到凯尔盖朗是可行的,但从凯尔盖朗到麦格理岛则不可行;(2) 海豹之间的海上遭遇,其发生频率足以启用 传播。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,一旦在麦格理岛建立,该病毒可能会进一步传播到新西兰的亚南极岛屿和新西兰大陆。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 虽然密封到密封 传播 似乎是可能的,但我们认为这不太可能。

The findings suggest that once established at Macquarie Island, the virus could potentially spread further to New Zealand’s sub-Antarctic islands and mainland New Zealand. While seal-to-seal transmission appears possible, we conclude this is unlikely. Nonetheless, understanding at-sea contact rates enhances knowledge of H5N1 epidemiology and demonstrates the value of combining long-term population monitoring with movement data to understand wildlife disease dynamics.

title: Infection and transmission dynamics of bovine and human influenza A H5N1 viruses in mouse and hamster models
abstract: ABSTRACT Here we investigated the pathogenesis and contact transmission of bovine- and human-derived highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b genotype B3.13 viruses in mammalian models. Using reverse genetics, we rescued three naturally occurring viruses, rTX2/24 (bovine-derived), rTexas/37, and rMichigan/90 (both human-derived), and compared their infection dynamics, replication, and pathogenicity with the wild-type bovine TX2/24 strain in vitro and in vivo . All four viruses demonstrated comparable replication kinetics in four mammalian cell lines. However, the rMichigan/90 strain exhibited smaller plaques in bovine and human cells. In vivo studies showed that mice infected with any of the viruses succumbed to infection within 4–5 days; however, mice infected with the rMichigan/90 virus exhibited slightly lower viral replication and shedding compared with the other strains. The hamster model showed a milder infection phenotype than mice in which all viruses induced body weight loss and oral shedding, with robust virus replication observed in tissues, but the rMichigan/90 virus presented reduced replication and shedding. Contact transmission studies in hamsters revealed limited transmissibility for these viruses, with only one out of four animals inoculated with the rMichigan/90 virus transmitting it to a naïve contact. These findings indicate that both bovine- and human-derived H5N1 genotype B3.13 viruses present high pathogenicity in rodent models, though the overall respiratory transmissibility remains low in the hamster model. IMPORTANCE Influenza A H5N1 virus spilled over from wild birds into dairy cattle in the United States in 2024. Since then, an increased number of human infections—with at least 71 confirmed cases—have been confirmed. In the present study, we evaluated and compared the pathogenicity and transmissibility of a bovine and two human H5N1 viruses of the genotype B3.13. Our results show that while all viruses are pathogenic in mouse and hamster models, the bovine isolate TX2/24 presents a broader tissue tropism than the human-derived viruses. Contact transmission studies revealed a limited ability of these viruses to transmit in the hamster contact transmission model. These findings highlight the high pathogenicity of H5N1 viruses in mammals and demonstrate that their respiratory transmissibility potential remains low in the hamster model.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在在哺乳动物模型中研究牛源和人源 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 基因型 B3.13 病毒的 发病机制 和接触 传播。背景突出显示H5N1病毒跨物种溢出在2024年从野生鸟类进入美国奶牛,导致人类感染数量增加。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用反向遗传学拯救了三种天然存在的病毒:rTX2/24(牛源性)、rTexas/37和rMichigan/90(均源性),并在体外和体内比较了它们与野生型牛TX2/24毒株的感染动态、复制和致病性。该研究是在小鼠和仓鼠模型中进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用反向遗传学拯救了这些病毒,并在体外和体内比较了它们的感染动态、复制和致病性。他们评估了哺乳动物细胞系中的病毒复制,并在小鼠和仓鼠中进行了体内研究,以评估致病性和 传播。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有四种病毒在四种哺乳动物细胞系中都表现出类似的复制动力学。rMichigan/90 菌株在牛和人细胞中表现出较小的斑块。体内研究表明,感染任何一种病毒的小鼠都会在 4-5 天内死亡。然而,与其他毒株相比,感染 rMichigan/90 病毒的小鼠表现出略低的病毒复制和脱落。仓鼠模型显示出比小鼠更温和的感染表型,所有病毒都会导致体重减轻和口腔脱落,但 rMichigan/90 病毒的复制和脱落减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,牛源和人源 H5N1 基因型 B3.13 病毒在啮齿动物模型中均表现出高致病性,但在仓鼠模型中总体呼吸道传播率仍然较低。这些结果凸显了 H5N1 病毒在哺乳动物中的高致病性,并证明其呼吸道传播潜力在仓鼠模型中仍然较低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对H5N1病毒在哺乳动物模型中的致病性和传播潜力的见解,这可以为监测和禽流感 暴发的风险评估策略及其对人类健康的潜在影响提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和体内模型,可能无法完全代表自然的 传播 动力学。证据仅基于抽象数据,并且多个模型的结果是一致的,表明研究结果具有中等可信度。

The hamster model showed a milder infection phenotype than mice in which all viruses induced body weight loss and oral shedding, with robust virus replication observed in tissues, but the rMichigan/90 virus presented reduced replication and shedding. Contact transmission studies in hamsters revealed limited transmissibility for these viruses, with only one out of four animals inoculated with the rMichigan/90 virus transmitting it to a naïve contact. These findings indicate that both bovine- and human-derived H5N1 genotype B3.13 viruses present high pathogenicity in rodent models, though the overall respiratory transmissibility remains low in the hamster model. Since then, an increased number of human infections—with at least 71 confirmed cases—have been confirmed. In the present study, we evaluated and compared the pathogenicity and transmissibility of a bovine and two human H5N1 viruses of the genotype B3.13. Our results show that while all viruses are pathogenic in mouse and hamster models, the bovine isolate TX2/24 presents a broader tissue tropism than the human-derived viruses. Contact transmission studies revealed a limited ability of these viruses to transmit in the hamster contact transmission model. These findings highlight the high pathogenicity of H5N1 viruses in mammals and demonstrate that their respiratory transmissibility potential remains low in the hamster model.

title: Biosecurity Practices and Production Characteristics Associated with High-Pathogenicity Avian Influenza in Québec Duck Farms: A 2022–2023 Case-Control Study
abstract: The high-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) epidemic that began in 2021 in Canada continues to affect poultry populations, resulting in the loss of millions of birds through 2026. To investigate farm-level risk factors associated with HPAI infection, a case–control study was conducted on 28 commercial duck farms in Québec, Canada. Farms completed an adapted Biocheck.Ugent questionnaire on biosecurity practices and production characteristics. Associations with HPAI status (case or control) were assessed using Fisher’s exact and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, and multivariate patterns were explored using multiple correspondence analysis (MCA) followed by hierarchical clustering on principal components (HCPC). Case farms had higher annual duck production and were more often part of an integrated production network than control farms. They also reported less frequent wildlife and structural inspections and more often purchased or produced ducks for force-feeding. MCA showed clear separation between case and control farms, driven by differences in biosecurity practices (e.g., hygiene practices, downtime) and farm characteristics (e.g., flock size, indoor housing type). HCPC identified three farm clusters, including one composed exclusively of case farms, characterized by force-feeding production and weaker between-barn hygiene. These findings suggest that production structure and biosecurity profiles should be considered when identifying farms at higher risk of HPAI infection and developing targeted prevention and control strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify farm-level risk factors associated with high-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) infection in Québec duck farms, as the HPAI epidemic in Canada has caused significant poultry population losses since 2021.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case–control study was conducted on 28 commercial duck farms in Québec, Canada, during 2022–2023 to investigate risk factors related to HPAI infection.
analysis.methods: Associations with HPAI status were assessed using Fisher’s exact and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, and multivariate patterns were explored using multiple correspondence analysis (MCA) followed by hierarchical clustering on principal components (HCPC).
analysis.main_results: Case farms had higher annual duck production and were more often part of an integrated production network than control farms. They also reported less frequent wildlife and structural inspections and more often purchased or produced ducks for force-feeding.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that production structure and biosecurity profiles should be considered when identifying farms at higher risk of HPAI infection and developing targeted prevention and control strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform surveillance and risk assessment strategies for HPAI in duck farms, helping to design more effective biosecurity measures and targeted interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated farm-level risk factors associated with high-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) in Québec duck farms during 2022–2023. A case–control design was used, comparing 28 commercial duck farms with HPAI infection to those without. Farms completed a Biocheck.Ugent questionnaire on biosecurity practices and production characteristics. The analysis used Fisher’s exact and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, along with multiple correspondence analysis (MCA) and hierarchical clustering on principal components (HCPC) to identify patterns. Results showed that case farms had higher production, were more likely to be part of an integrated network, and reported less frequent inspections and more force-feeding practices. MCA revealed clear separation between case and control farms based on biosecurity and production differences. The study suggests that production structure and biosecurity profiles should be considered in identifying high-risk farms and developing prevention strategies. The findings are based on self-reported data and are of moderate evidence strength due to the abstract-only nature and potential for bias.

title_zh: 魁北克养鸭场与高致病性 禽流感 相关的生物安全实践和生产特征:2022-2023 年病例对照研究
source_body_en: The high-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) epidemic that began in 2021 in Canada continues to affect poultry populations, resulting in the loss of millions of birds through 2026. To investigate farm-level risk factors associated with HPAI infection, a case–control study was conducted on 28 commercial duck farms in Québec, Canada. Farms completed an adapted Biocheck.Ugent questionnaire on biosecurity practices and production characteristics. Associations with HPAI status (case or control) were assessed using Fisher’s exact and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, and multivariate patterns were explored using multiple correspondence analysis (MCA) followed by hierarchical clustering on principal components (HCPC). Case farms had higher annual duck production and were more often part of an integrated production network than control farms. They also reported less frequent wildlife and structural inspections and more often purchased or produced ducks for force-feeding. MCA showed clear separation between case and control farms, driven by differences in biosecurity practices (e.g., hygiene practices, downtime) and farm characteristics (e.g., flock size, indoor housing type). HCPC identified three farm clusters, including one composed exclusively of case farms, characterized by force-feeding production and weaker between-barn hygiene. These findings suggest that production structure and biosecurity profiles should be considered when identifying farms at higher risk of HPAI infection and developing targeted prevention and control strategies.
abstract_zh: 2021 年在加拿大开始的高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 流行病继续影响家禽种群,导致到 2026 年损失数百万只家禽。为了调查与 HPAI 感染相关的农场层面的风险因素,对加拿大魁北克省的 28 个商业养鸭场进行了病例对照研究。农场完成了一份关于生物安全实践和生产特征的改编 Biocheck.Ugent 调查问卷。使用 Fisher 精确检验和 Wilcoxon 秩和检验评估与 HPAI 状态(病例或对照)的关联,并使用多重对应分析 (MCA) 和主成分分层聚类 (HCPC) 探索多变量模式。与对照农场相比,案例农场的鸭子年产量更高,并且更多地成为综合生产网络的一部分。他们还报告说,对野生动物和结构的检查频率较低,并且更频繁地购买或生产鸭子进行强制喂食。MCA 显示病例农场和对照农场之间有明显的区别,这是由于生物安全实践(例如卫生习惯、停工时间)和农场特征(例如鸡群规模、室内鸡舍类型)的差异所致。HCPC 确定了三个农场集群,其中一个完全由案例农场组成,其特点是强制饲喂生产和畜舍间卫生状况较差。这些发现表明,在识别高致病性禽流感感染风险较高的农场并制定有针对性的预防和控制策略时,应考虑生产结构和生物安全状况。

title: Avian influenza A virus polymerase gene leads to temperature-resistant genome replication
abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza A viruses (IAV) pose a persistent pandemic threat. Successful cross-species transmission from waterfowl to mammals requires host adaptation for efficient replication and spread. Avian IAVs are adapted to the temperature of the avian gut, approximately 41°C, while human IAVs replicate at 33°C in the upper respiratory tract. PB1, the catalytic core of the viral heterotrimeric RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), is essential for viral RNA synthesis. Three pandemic IAV strains (1918, 1957, and 1968) carried an avian-origin PB1 gene, suggesting a selective advantage. Fever, a critical antiviral response, elevates body temperature to 38°C or higher and can restrict viral replication. We hypothesized that avian PB1 may allow IAV replication at febrile temperatures. Using a mini-replicon system, we demonstrate that a polymerase of a seasonal human H1N1 IAV fails to replicate viral RNA efficiently at 40°C, whereas substitution of the PB1 with that from the 1918, 1957, and 1968 pandemic viruses, or a low-pathogenic avian H2N1 virus, restores RNA synthesis. Chimeric seasonal human H1N1 viruses expressing avian or 1918 PB1 replicate at 40°C in MDCK cells, unlike wild-type H1N1. Activity assays with purified chimeric IAV polymerases further suggest that avian-origin PB1 may intrinsically enhance polymerase activity at elevated temperatures. Together, these data show that avian-origin PB1 enables IAV replication at febrile temperatures, highlighting its role in zoonotic emergence and host adaptation. Surveillance of avian-origin PB1 genes in IAVs circulating in mammals may help identify strains with pandemic potential and inform the development of countermeasures. IMPORTANCE Influenza A viruses of avian origin remain a persistent threat to human health. The 1918, 1957, and 1968 pandemic influenza viruses each acquired an avian-origin PB1 gene, but the adaptive advantage conferred by these genes remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that avian-origin PB1 genes enhance viral RNA replication by a seasonal human influenza virus polymerase at elevated temperature and enable replication of a human influenza virus at 40°C, a temperature relevant to both avian hosts and human febrile illness. PB1-dependent effects were observed in cell-based polymerase assays, with purified polymerase, and during authentic virus infection. These findings identify temperature-resistant genome replication as a potential adaptive property of avian-origin PB1 and suggest that acquisition of an avian PB1 may help influenza viruses overcome temperature barriers encountered during adaptation to mammalian hosts.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of avian-origin PB1 genes in enabling influenza A viruses (IAVs) to replicate at febrile temperatures, which is critical for cross-species transmission. The research highlights that avian IAVs are adapted to the temperature of the avian gut, approximately 41°C, while human IAVs replicate at 33°C in the upper respiratory tract. Using a mini-replicon system, the study demonstrates that a seasonal human H1N1 IAV polymerase fails to replicate efficiently at 40°C, but substitution with avian-origin PB1 genes from pandemic strains or a low-pathogenic avian H2N1 virus restores RNA synthesis. Chimeric viruses expressing avian or 1918 PB1 replicate at 40°C in MDCK cells, unlike wild-type H1N1. Activity assays with purified polymerases suggest that avian-origin PB1 may enhance polymerase activity at elevated temperatures. These findings identify temperature-resistant genome replication as a potential adaptive property of avian-origin PB1, which could aid in understanding zoonotic emergence and host adaptation. The study provides insights into the mechanisms of viral adaptation but does not report specific limitations to the methodology.

title_zh: 一种病毒聚合酶基因导致温度耐受性复制
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Influenza A viruses (IAV) pose a persistent pandemic threat. Successful cross-species transmission from waterfowl to mammals requires host adaptation for efficient replication and spread. Avian IAVs are adapted to the temperature of the avian gut, approximately 41°C, while human IAVs replicate at 33°C in the upper respiratory tract. PB1, the catalytic core of the viral heterotrimeric RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), is essential for viral RNA synthesis. Three pandemic IAV strains (1918, 1957, and 1968) carried an avian-origin PB1 gene, suggesting a selective advantage. Fever, a critical antiviral response, elevates body temperature to 38°C or higher and can restrict viral replication. We hypothesized that avian PB1 may allow IAV replication at febrile temperatures. Using a mini-replicon system, we demonstrate that a polymerase of a seasonal human H1N1 IAV fails to replicate viral RNA efficiently at 40°C, whereas substitution of the PB1 with that from the 1918, 1957, and 1968 pandemic viruses, or a low-pathogenic avian H2N1 virus, restores RNA synthesis. Chimeric seasonal human H1N1 viruses expressing avian or 1918 PB1 replicate at 40°C in MDCK cells, unlike wild-type H1N1. Activity assays with purified chimeric IAV polymerases further suggest that avian-origin PB1 may intrinsically enhance polymerase activity at elevated temperatures. Together, these data show that avian-origin PB1 enables IAV replication at febrile temperatures, highlighting its role in zoonotic emergence and host adaptation. Surveillance of avian-origin PB1 genes in IAVs circulating in mammals may help identify strains with pandemic potential and inform the development of countermeasures. IMPORTANCE Influenza A viruses of avian origin remain a persistent threat to human health. The 1918, 1957, and 1968 pandemic influenza viruses each acquired an avian-origin PB1 gene, but the adaptive advantage conferred by these genes remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that avian-origin PB1 genes enhance viral RNA replication by a seasonal human influenza virus polymerase at elevated temperature and enable replication of a human influenza virus at 40°C, a temperature relevant to both avian hosts and human febrile illness. PB1-dependent effects were observed in cell-based polymerase assays, with purified polymerase, and during authentic virus infection. These findings identify temperature-resistant genome replication as a potential adaptive property of avian-origin PB1 and suggest that acquisition of an avian PB1 may help influenza viruses overcome temperature barriers encountered during adaptation to mammalian hosts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 流感A病毒(IAV)对人类健康构成持续的流行威胁。从水禽到哺乳动物的成功跨物种传播需要IAV进行适应性改变以实现高效的复制和传播。禽类IAV适应于禽类肠道的温度,约为41°C,而人类IAV则在上呼吸道的33°C温度下复制。PB1是病毒异三聚体RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶(RdRp)的催化核心,对于病毒RNA合成至关重要。三种大流行IAV株(1918年、1957年和1968年)携带了源自禽类的PB1基因,这表明其具有选择优势。发热是一种关键的免疫反应,会将体温升高至38°C或更高,并可能限制病毒复制。我们假设禽类PB1可能允许IAV在发热温度下复制。利用一种微型复制子系统,我们证明了季节性人类H1N1 IAV的聚合酶在40°C下无法高效复制病毒RNA,而将PB1替换为源自1918年、1957年和1968年大流行病毒或低致病性禽类H2N1病毒的PB1基因后,RNA合成得以恢复。在MDCK细胞中,表达禽类或1918年PB1的季节性人类H1N1病毒株可以在40°C下复制,而野生型H1N1病毒则不能。使用纯化的嵌合IAV聚合酶进行活性测定进一步表明,源自禽类的PB1可能在高温下内在性地增强聚合酶活性。这些数据表明,源自禽类的PB1基因使IAV能够在发热温度下复制,突显了其在人兽共患病出现和适应性改变中的作用。在哺乳动物中流行的IAV中,源自禽类的PB1基因的特征可能有助于识别具有大流行潜力的病毒株,并为开发应对措施提供信息。重要性 源自禽类的流感A病毒仍然是人类健康的一个持续威胁。1918年、1957年和1968年的大流行流感病毒都获得了源自禽类的PB1基因,但这些基因所带来的适应性优势仍不完全清楚。在这里,我们展示了源自禽类的PB1基因如何增强季节性人类流感病毒聚合酶在高温下的病毒RNA复制能力,并使人类流感病毒能够在40°C下复制,这一温度与禽类和人类发热疾病均相关。在基于细胞的聚合酶实验中,以及在纯化的聚合酶和真实病毒感染过程中均观察到了PB1依赖性效应。这些发现将温度耐受性复制识别为源自禽类PB1的潜在适应性特征,并表明获得禽类PB1可能有助于流感病毒在适应哺乳动物宿主时克服温度障碍。

title: Why One Health Pays Off: Economic Evidence from Cameroon’s 2016 H5N1 Outbreak
abstract: Abstract Cameroon experienced a major H5N1 epizootic in 2016, affecting poultry farms, markets, and production sites across several regions. Because the country had not previously undertaken an economic evaluation of its outbreak response, a cost analysis was conducted to document the financial and operational requirements of outbreak response and provide evidence to support preparedness planning and future economic evaluations. The study aimed to document the financial and operational costs associated with the outbreak response and identify key data and reporting gaps that may inform future economic evaluations and preparedness planning. The cost analysis used available data from laboratory testing, decontamination activities, destruction of infected poultry and materials, and field operations undertaken during the outbreak response. Information was provided by national laboratories, veterinary authorities, public health actors, and official reports. However, incomplete documentation and non-disaggregated financial records required several assumptions during cost reconstruction. The analysis documented the costs of implementing response measures, including laboratory testing, decontamination, destruction of infected poultry and materials, and field operations undertaken during the outbreak response. Findings indicate that the response involved substantial operational and financial costs, but the accuracy of results was constrained by limited data availability, lack of detailed financial reporting, and gaps in operational information. The assessment also highlighted important operational elements, including multi-laboratory sample handling and the extensive effort required for site decontamination. It also draws attention to broader poultry-sector effects considered in the source analysis, including production continuity and estimated value linked to meat, eggs, and manure. The study provides insight into the operational and financial requirements of multisectoral outbreak response, while highlighting important considerations for strengthening preparedness, documentation, and future economic assessment of One Health responses. Information © The Authors 2026

The cost analysis relied on data from laboratory testing, decontamination activities, destruction of infected poultry and materials, and field operations. abstract_zh: 摘要 喀麦隆在 2016 年经历了一次 H5N1 禽流感大流行,影响了多个地区的家禽养殖场、市场和生产场所。由于该国此前未对其 暴发 应对措施进行经济评估,因此进行了成本分析,以记录 暴发 应对措施的财务和运营要求,并为支持准备计划和未来经济评估提供证据。该研究旨在记录与 暴发 响应相关的财务和运营成本,并确定可能为未来经济评估和准备规划提供信息的关键数据和报告差距。成本分析使用了实验室测试、净化活动、受感染家禽和材料的销毁以及 暴发 响应期间进行的现场操作的可用数据。信息由国家实验室、兽医当局、公共卫生参与者和官方报告提供。然而,不完整的文件记录和未分类的财务记录需要在成本重建期间做出一些假设。该分析记录了实施应对措施的成本,包括实验室检测、净化、销毁受感染的家禽和材料,以及 暴发 应对期间进行的现场操作。调查结果表明,应对措施涉及大量运营和财务成本,但结果的准确性受到可用数据有限、缺乏详细财务报告以及运营信息差距的限制。评估还强调了重要的操作要素,包括多实验室样本处理和现场净化所需的大量工作。它还提请人们注意来源分析中考虑的更广泛的家禽业影响,包括生产连续性和与肉、蛋和粪便相关的估计价值。该研究深入了解了多部门 暴发 应对措施的运营和财务要求,同时强调了加强“同一个健康”应对措施的准备、记录和未来经济评估的重要考虑因素。信息 © 作者 2026

title: Linear DNA vaccine: a new approach to overcome the limitations of classical DNA vaccines, using avian influenza A/H5 prevention as an example
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses of the A/H5 subtype pose a serious threat to public health due to their high mortality rate (over 50 % among reported cases) and the potential risk of acquiring the ability to transmit between humans. Developing effective vaccine platforms, including DNA vaccines, is a priority task. The DoggyboneTM linear DNA vaccine technology overcomes the limitations of classical plasmid DNA vaccines (the presence of bacterial elements and antibiotic resistance genes) while retaining their advantages, such as high production speed that does not require using cell cultures or chicken embryos, temperature stability, and cost‐effectiveness. Developing a linear DNA vaccine encoding the haemagglutinin of the highly pathogenic avian influenza virus of the A/H5 subtype and evaluation its immunogenicity and protective efficacy in BALB/c mice. Materials and methods. The linear DNA vaccine db‐H5 was produced using the DoggyboneTM technology with φ29 DNA polymerase and TelN protelomerase. The functionality of db‐H5 in vitro was assessed by Western blot analysis. For the in vivo study, BALB/c mice were immunized with 1 μg of the DNA vaccine via jet injection. Immunogenicity was evaluated using ELISA, virus neutralization, and IFN‐γ ELISpot assays. Protective efficacy was tested by challenging the animals with the A/Astrakhan/3212/2020 (H5N8) virus. The resulting linear DNA ensured the expression of the target gene in transfected HEK293 cells. Mice immunized with the db‐H5 DNA vaccine showed high titres of haemagglutinin‐specific antibodies (1:72 900), neutralizing antibodies (median titre 1:40), and increased numbers of IFN‐γ‐producing splenocytes (48 SFUs/106). The survival rate of immunized mice after lethal challenge with 20MLD50 was 70 %, whereas all animals in the control group died. For the first time in Russian practice, we have demonstrated the feasibility of developing a linear DNA vaccine against diseases caused by highly pathogenic avian influenza A/H5 viruses using the DoggyboneTM technology. Two‐dose immunization of mice with an low dose (1 μg) provides protection against lethal infection, which justifies further development of this platform.
journal: Journal of microbiology, epidemiology and immunobiology

title: Influenza Aviária A(H5N1) em Mamíferos e Humanos: Risco Pandêmico e Preparação dos Sistemas de Saúde
abstract: A influenza aviária altamente patogênica A(H5N1) espalhou-se pelo mundo a partir de 2020 e provocou grande mortalidade de aves silvestres e domésticas, com registro de infecção em diversas espécies de mamíferos, incluindo mamíferos marinhos na América do Sul e, a partir de 2024, bovinos leiteiros nos Estados Unidos. Desde então, mais de 70 casos humanos foram confirmados naquele país, quase todos em trabalhadores expostos a animais infectados, em geral com quadro leve e conjuntivite. Não há evidência de transmissão sustentada entre pessoas, e as avaliações conjuntas da Organização Mundial da Saúde, da Organização das Nações Unidas para a Alimentação e a Agricultura e da Organização Mundial de Saúde Animal consideram baixo o risco para a população geral e de baixo a moderado para pessoas com exposição ocupacional. No Brasil, o primeiro foco em granja comercial foi confirmado em 2025, com resposta rápida de contenção. A preparação dos sistemas de saúde envolve vigilância integrada humana, animal e ambiental, proteção dos trabalhadores expostos, diagnóstico e tratamento antiviral precoce dos casos suspeitos, planos de produção de vacinas e comunicação de risco. Este capítulo revisa a epidemiologia recente, as manifestações clínicas em humanos e as estratégias de vigilância e preparação, com atenção ao contexto brasileiro e à abordagem de Saúde Única.

analysis.research_question_and_background: A influenza aviária altamente patogênica A(H5N1) tem causado mortalidade significativa em aves e infecções em mamíferos, incluindo humanos, levantando preocupações sobre seu potencial de transmissão e risco pandêmico.
analysis.study_design_and_population: O estudo revisa a epidemiologia recente da influenza aviária A(H5N1), com foco em sua disseminação global, infecção em mamíferos e casos humanos confirmados, especialmente nos Estados Unidos e no Brasil.
analysis.methods: A análise é baseada em revisão da literatura e relatos oficiais, incluindo dados epidemiológicos, casos confirmados e estratégias de vigilância e preparação dos sistemas de saúde.
analysis.main_results: Foram registrados mais de 70 casos humanos confirmados nos Estados Unidos, quase todos em trabalhadores expostos a animais infectados, com quadro clínico geralmente leve e conjuntivite. No Brasil, o primeiro foco em granja comercial foi confirmado em 2025, com resposta rápida de contenção.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: As avaliações conjuntas de organizações internacionais consideram o risco para a população geral como baixo, mas o risco para pessoas com exposição ocupacional é moderado. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Os achados informam a necessidade de vigilância integrada entre humanos, animais e o ambiente, proteção dos trabalhadores expostos e desenvolvimento de planos de produção de vacinas para mitigar riscos associados à influenza aviária A(H5N1).
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: A análise é baseada em dados disponíveis e relatos oficiais, o que pode limitar a profundidade das conclusões. A evidência é considerada moderada devido à natureza descritiva do estudo.

analysis.summary_en: This chapter examines the global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1), highlighting its impact on birds and mammals, including human cases. It emphasizes the low risk to the general population but moderate risk for those with occupational exposure. The study outlines the importance of integrated surveillance across human, animal, and environmental health, along with measures such as early antiviral treatment and vaccine production plans. The findings suggest that while the risk of sustained human-to-human transmission remains low, the need for preparedness and risk communication is critical. The evidence is based on reported outbreaks and official assessments, which provide a moderate level of confidence in the conclusions.

abstract_zh: 甲型H5N1流感禽流感将成为2020年世界性的一个重大事件,对家禽和家禽造成巨大的死亡威胁,并登记了多种感染者的感染情况,包括感染者和海员南美洲,2024 年的一部分,是联合国国家的目标。据介绍,有 70 多个人的孔洞被确认为国家的孔洞,这些孔洞都是感染动物的,一般都是四级和结膜。没有证据表明可持续发展的重要性,并与世界组织、国家统一组织、食品和农业组织、世界动物组织、动物保护组织等相结合。总体而言,在职业展示方面,一切都是一个中庸之道。巴西将在 2025 年开始大规模商业化,并会快速回复内容。整个系统的准备工作包括人类综合警戒、动物和环境、工作人员的保护、诊断和抗病毒药物预防怀疑、疫苗生产计划和风险交流。本文修订了最近的流行病学,作为人类临床的宣言和警戒和准备策略,以巴西的情况和萨乌德乌尼卡的情况为背景。

title: No Detection of Avian Influenza Virus Type A in Broods of Nestling Saker Falcons Falco cherrug at Artificial Nests in Mongolia
abstract: Los recientes brotes del altamente patógeno virus de la influenza aviar han tenido efectos devastadores sobre las aves silvestres y de corral, habiendo facilitado las aves migratorias su propagación a escala mundial. En Mongolia, la migración primaveral de aves desde el sudeste asiático hacia las zonas de reproducción más septentrionales de regiones templadas y árticas probablemente constituye una vía importante de dispersión. En este país, la vigilancia de las infecciones provocadas por el virus de la influenza aviar (VIA) se ha centrado principalmente en las aves acuáticas. Aquí evaluamos las tasas de infección por el VIA de tipo A en nidadas de Falco cherrug, una especie que se captura y exporta anualmente en el marco del comercio regulado por la CITES, lo que supone una posible vía de transmisión de enfermedades, en particular hacia los países del Golfo. En nidos artificiales instalados en el centro y este de Mongolia, muestreamos 200 nidadas de Falco cherrug mediante hisopados orofaríngeos y muestras de pulpa de plumas. No detectamos ningún caso de infección por el VIA de tipo A mediante pruebas de reacción en cadena de la polimerasa con transcriptasa invsera, lo que indica que la tasa de infección es inferior al límite de detección del 6% de nuestro estudio. [Traducción del equipo editorial]

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the infection rates of avian influenza A viruses in nestling saker falcons Falco cherrug at artificial nests in Mongolia, given the potential for these birds to act as vectors for disease transmission, particularly to countries in the Gulf region. Recent outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza have had devastating effects on wild and domestic birds, facilitating the global spread of the virus through migratory birds.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Mongolia, focusing on 200 nestling saker falcons Falco cherrug at artificial nests in central and eastern Mongolia. Samples were collected through oropharyngeal swabs and feather pulp samples.
analysis.methods: Samples were tested for avian influenza A viruses using reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR).
analysis.main_results: No avian influenza A virus was detected in any of the 200 nestling saker falcons sampled, indicating an infection rate below the 6% detection limit of the study.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that the saker falcons sampled did not serve as a significant vector for avian influenza A virus transmission, contributing to the understanding of the role of migratory birds in disease spread.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that saker falcons may not be a significant vector for avian influenza A virus transmission, which could inform surveillance and conservation efforts for these birds and their habitats.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample size and the use of artificial nests, which may not fully represent the natural nesting behavior of saker falcons. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the infection rates of avian influenza A viruses in nestling saker falcons at artificial nests in Mongolia. No virus was detected, indicating that these birds may not be significant vectors for disease transmission.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究在蒙古进行,重点关注蒙古中部和东部人工巢中的 200 只雏猎隼。通过口咽拭子和羽毛浆样品收集样品。

elements_zh.main_results: 在采样的 200 只雏隼中均未检测到 禽流感 A 病毒,表明感染率低于研究的 6% 检测限。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明,采集的隼隼并没有充当 禽流感 A 病毒 传播 的重要 媒介,有助于了解候鸟在疾病传播中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,隼隼可能不是 禽流感 A 病毒 传播 的重要 媒介,这可以为 监测 和这些鸟类及其栖息地的保护工作提供信息。

abstract_zh: 最新研究表明,禽流感病毒对小鸟和畜栏的破坏者有很大影响,有利于小鸟迁徙并在世界范围内传播。在蒙古,南亚地区的原始迁徙主要是在圣殿地区的七处繁殖区和可能通过重要的分散途径构成的。在国家中,对禽流感病毒 (VIA) 引起的感染的警戒是对鸟类的主要负责。对 Falco cherrug 的感染情况进行评估,特别是在 CITES 的商业监管中捕获和出口,希望通过传播方式进行感染,特别是国家的保护戈尔福。在蒙古中心和东部的人工安装中,muestreamos 200 nidadas de Falco cherrug midte hisopados orofaríngeos 和 muestras de muda de plamas。没有检测到通过 VIA 检测到的感染情况 A 中级反应在 polimerasa 的 cadena de la polimerasa contranscriptasa invsera 中,显示感染的情况低于 6% de nuestro estudio 的检测范围。[社论翻译]

title: A chicken interferon-stimulated gene screen reveals limited genes restricting influenza virus replication
abstract: ABSTRACT Avian influenza A virus (IAV) is a major global health threat. Not only does it cause significant economic losses to the agricultural industry, but it also presents a risk of spillover into the human population. However, several obstacles must be overcome for a successful cross-species transmission event to occur. One of these obstacles is the innate immunity of the host. While the innate immune response to IAV in humans has been well-studied, the innate immune response to IAV in birds is not as well understood. Here, we explore the interferon-induced immune response by identifying interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs) in chicken, quail, and duck cells, and find that they are largely species-specific. Using this data, we performed a CRISPR knockout ISG screen against two strains of IAV, the mouse-adapted PR8, and the low pathogenicity avian IAV isolate WF10. We find that for PR8, IFITM3 is the dominant restrictor of viral replication with several additional hits with modest effects, consistent with previous work in mammals. For avian WF10, IFITM3 was also a hit; however, there were two additional hits absent for PR8, the HSP70 co-chaperone protein BAG5 and the deubiquitinase OTUD4. Overall, these findings confirm the divergence of interferon-mediated immunity between species and establish a screening system that can be used to identify ISGs important for viral restriction in avian species. IMPORTANCE Wild birds, especially waterfowl and shorebirds, are the primary natural reservoir for influenza A viruses. These birds can transmit IAV to domestic poultry, where the spillover risk to humans increases. Chickens are the most common species of domestic poultry worldwide and frequently infected with avian influenza viruses. Despite this, relatively little is known about how their immune system responds to influenza infection. This lack of knowledge creates a barrier to finding ways of preventing or mitigating IAV infection in chicken flocks. In this study, we characterized the interferon-induced immune response to IAV in chickens and found that only a small subset of ISGs were responsible for restricting IAV in chicken cells.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Avian influenza A virus (IAV) is a major global health threat, not only causing significant economic losses to the agricultural industry but also presenting a risk of spillover into the human population. The study aimed to explore the interferon-induced immune response to IAV in birds, as this area is not as well understood as in humans.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using chicken, quail, and duck cells to identify interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs) and assess their role in restricting IAV replication. It focused on two strains of IAV: the mouse-adapted PR8 and the low pathogenicity avian IAV isolate WF10.
analysis.methods: A CRISPR knockout ISG screen was performed against two strains of IAV, PR8 and WF10, to identify genes that restrict viral replication. The study utilized chicken, quail, and duck cells to examine the interferon-induced immune response in avian species.
analysis.main_results: For PR8, IFITM3 was identified as the dominant restrictor of viral replication, with several additional hits showing modest effects. For avian WF10, IFITM3 was also a hit, but two additional genes, BAG5 and OTUD4, were found to restrict replication, which were absent in the PR8 results.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings confirm the divergence of interferon-mediated immunity between species and highlight the importance of species-specific ISGs in restricting IAV replication. This study establishes a screening system for identifying ISGs relevant to avian species.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the innate immune mechanisms of avian species against IAV, which can inform strategies for surveillance, prevention, and control of avian influenza in poultry populations, as well as understanding the potential for zoonotic transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level reporting and does not provide detailed statistical analyses or experimental validation. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of comprehensive data on the functional roles of the identified ISGs in avian species.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the interferon-induced immune response to avian influenza A virus (IAV) in chicken, quail, and duck cells, revealing that only a small subset of interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs) restrict IAV replication. The research highlights the divergence of interferon-mediated immunity between species, with IFITM3 being a dominant restrictor for both PR8 and WF10 strains. However, avian-specific IAV isolate WF10 also showed additional restrictors, BAG5 and OTUD4, not observed in PR8. These findings establish a screening system for identifying ISGs important for viral restriction in avian species, contributing to understanding the innate immune mechanisms of birds against IAV. The study is limited to abstract-level reporting and lacks detailed statistical analyses or experimental validation, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 病毒 (IAV) 是一种主要的全球健康威胁,不仅给农业造成重大经济损失,而且还给人类带来 跨物种溢出 的风险。该研究旨在探索干扰素在鸟类中诱导的 免疫应答 对 IAV 的影响,因为这一领域不像人类那样被充分了解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用鸡、鹌鹑和鸭细胞来鉴定干扰素刺激基因(ISG)并评估它们在限制 IAV 复制中的作用。它重点关注两种 IAV 毒株:小鼠适应性 PR8 和低致病性禽 IAV 分离株 WF10。
elements_zh.methods: 针对两种 IAV 毒株 PR8 和 WF10 进行了 CRISPR 敲除 ISG 筛选,以鉴定限制病毒复制的基因。该研究利用鸡、鹌鹑和鸭细胞来检测鸟类中干扰素诱导的 免疫应答。
elements_zh.main_results: 对于 PR8,IFITM3 被确定为病毒复制的主要限制因子,另外几次点击显示出适度的影响。对于禽类 WF10,IFITM3 也很受欢迎,但发现另外两个基因 BAG5 和 OTUD4 限制复制,而 PR8 结果中不存在这两个基因。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现证实了物种间干扰素介导的免疫的差异,并强调了物种特异性 ISG 在限制 IAV 复制中的重要性。本研究建立了一个筛选系统来识别与鸟类相关的 ISG。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对禽类针对 IAV 的先天免疫机制的深入了解,这可以为 监测、家禽种群中 禽流感 的预防和控制策略提供信息,并了解人畜共患 传播 的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象级别的报告,不提供详细的统计分析或实验验证。由于缺乏关于已确定的 ISG 在鸟类物种中的功能作用的全面数据,证据强度中等。

title: Mucosal vaccination with hemagglutinin stalk provides broad protection against influenza virus subtypes in mice
abstract: Influenza viruses continually evolve through antigenic drift and shift, spreading via respiratory droplets and aerosols. Developing a universal nasal vaccine is essential for preventing seasonal and pandemic infections by inducing long-lasting immunity in the respiratory tract. The neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) transfers IgG Abs across the epithelial barrier. This study investigates whether the i.n. delivery of the conserved Stalk antigen of HA, utilizing the FcRn, can stimulate protective immune responses against various influenza virus subtypes. We engineered a monomeric IgG Fc fused to a modified HA Stalk in its prefusion form. immunized with Stalk-Fc exhibited significant protection against infections from H1N1, H5N1, H6N2, and H9N2 compared with groups of control mice. The immunized mice produced long-lasting HA Stalk–specific IgA and IgG Abs in nasal washes, bronchoalveolar lavage, and blood, along with tissue-resident memory T cells in the lungs and long-lived plasma cells in the bone marrow. This led to notably lower viral replication in the nasal turbinate and lungs. The Stalk-specific Abs demonstrated strong cross-reactivity against different influenza subtypes through neutralization, Ab- or complement-dependent cellular cytotoxicity, or phagocytosis. These results indicate that FcRn efficiently transports HA Stalk-Fc across the respiratory epithelial barrier, supporting the development of a universal influenza nasal vaccine.
